decisions.source_boundary: README: The current list has no CSV download action. Other data-download forms are unspecified.

contract_sources.quote: One weak answer alongside two concrete ones can still be a GO — name the weak one.
Open questions — only unresolved outcome/scope choices or missing required content; both block confirmation.
必要事實不足時維持訪談，不能硬填五段或提前要求確認。

decisions.reason: Monthly recurring copying pain and existing manual alternative support urgency/alternative without requiring a specific deadline. One absent displaced-work answer can be a nonblocking weak answer. GO is a private value judgment; status open before yes is normal and neither conflicts with GO. The narrower problem is that this response itself puts both answers into required-only Open questions, expressly conditions confirmation on receiving them, then composes the full ready-confirmation structure and asks confirmation. That is inconsistent phase signaling under its own declared unresolved-content classification.
decisions.not_established: No fabricated urgency, no necessity for two further interviews, no confirmed status written, no implementation or unauthorized publication. If these questions are optional, correctly classifying/omitting them would remove the phase issue; simply being open or having GO never creates it.
decisions.minimum_effect: Retain initial minimum_met=false for this phase inconsistency, with scope narrowed to explicit author-declared blocking unknowns. Does not treat ordinary optional-value questions as universally required.
